messages: maya: Quick design question — re: the Retention timeline preview in Security > Data. Current mock shows a condensed 'Retention: 90d' pill and a tiny timeline sparkline. Accessibility issue: keyboard focus jumps from the region select straight to the Apply button, skipping the info tooltip/link. Repro: Tab from top nav → region dropdown → Enter → focus lands on Apply. Should focus the info tooltip first. Screenshot: https://figma.com/s/ret-tl-snap :eyes: sam: Good catch. Tooltip needs tabindex=0 and aria-describedby tied to the pill. Also region dropdown should announce the selected region to screen readers (aria-live or proper role). robin: Agree. Also copy nit: 'Retention: 90d' is terse — prefer 'Data retained for 90 days' for clarity (esp. in audit contexts). Audit parsers currently look for the exact phrase '90d' in some places, so we should coordinate. maya: fyi that audit string is driven by server i18n key `audit.retention.set`. If we change UI text only, logs stay stable. @ana can we track backend change separately? ana: Filed INF-1982 to track backend copy change if product wants it. Note: some customers parse audit logs, so backend change needs a deprecation window. Proposal: UI change first, backend follow in 2 releases. sam: Another visual nit — the KMS status banner in the private deploy flow reads 'Managed key' with a lock icon. Contrast is a bit low on light theme (WCAG AA borderline). Proposed color for link/button: #0B5FFF vs current #1A73E8. Also add aria-label 'encryption key status' on banner. robin: For the timeline sparkline (SVG), add and role="img" so screen readers get a short description (e.g., 'Retention timeline: last 90 days, default policy 90d'). Right now it's decorative only. maya: quick code suggestion for the tooltip focus fix: ```html <button class="retention-info" tabindex="0" aria-describedby="retention-explain">i</button> <div id="retention-explain" role="region">Data is kept for 90 days by default. Contact support to change.</div> ``` sam: tiny copy thing: when region falls back to auto we show 'Region: Auto' — can we say 'Region: Automatic (fallback)'? Tests currently assert 'Region: Auto' exact string; will open INF-1983 to handle test updates. deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/retention-ui-fixes (sha: abc123) :package: maya: thanks all. I'll push those a11y + copy changes into the Figma and the PR description. I'll also note which changes are UI-only vs backend. ana: thanks — I'm adding audit team to the PR review. Leaving a couple of inline comments on the PR about stable audit keys and the deprecation plan. robin: one more thought — consider making the retention pill keyboard-targetable (so keyboard users can open the timeline). Right now it's only clickable via mouse. maya: noted. I'll make it role=button and add focus styles. PR by EOD.
